summary: Frontend testing completed for Expense Management, Finance Analytics, and EditProjectModal Budget field changes. All 11 features verified working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Expense Management, Finance Analytics, and EditProjectModal Budget field changes fully tested and working.

expense_management_stats_cards.description: Expense Management page shows 5 stats cards: Total Expenses, Pending Approval, Approved, Total Amount, Approved Amount
expense_management_stats_cards.evidence: Screenshot shows all 5 stat cards with values: Total Expenses (12), Pending Approval (0), Approved (12), Total Amount (₹77,000), Approved Amount (₹77,000)

add_expense_button.description: Add Expense button opens modal with data-testid='add-expense-btn'
add_expense_button.evidence: Button found with data-testid and opens modal correctly

add_expense_modal_pid_selection.description: Add Expense modal has PID selection dropdown with data-testid='pid-select'
add_expense_modal_pid_selection.evidence: PID dropdown found with 8 options, selecting a PID works correctly

add_expense_modal_budget_info.description: When PID is selected, budget info is displayed (Order Value, Execution Budget, Available Budget)
add_expense_modal_budget_info.evidence: Screenshot shows budget info panel with Order Value (₹4,95,600), Execution Budget (₹0), Available Budget (₹0), Used (₹0 Approved expenses)

add_expense_form_fields.description: Add Expense form has all required fields: Category, Amount, Description, Vendor, Bill/Receipt No, Date, Payment Mode, Remarks
add_expense_form_fields.evidence: All fields verified present in modal: Category dropdown, Amount input, Description textarea, Vendor/Supplier input, Bill/Receipt No input, Date picker, Payment Mode dropdown, Remarks textarea

add_expense_file_upload.description: File upload section exists for attaching bills/receipts
add_expense_file_upload.evidence: Attach Bill/Receipt section with upload area found, accepts JPG, PNG, PDF, DOC, XLS (Max 10MB)

finance_analytics_stat_cards.description: Finance Analytics page shows 4 main stat cards: Total Revenue, Actual Expenses, Net Profit, Total Budget
finance_analytics_stat_cards.evidence: Screenshot shows 4 colored stat cards: Total Revenue (₹8.22Cr, 375 projects), Actual Expenses (₹0, From Expense Management), Net Profit (₹8.22Cr, 100% margin), Total Budget (₹62.3L, Allocated for execution)

finance_analytics_expense_source.description: Finance Analytics clearly states 'From Expense Management' under Actual Expenses
finance_analytics_expense_source.evidence: Actual Expenses card shows 'From Expense Management' text below the amount

finance_analytics_profit_note.description: Finance Analytics has note explaining profit calculation excludes requests
finance_analytics_profit_note.evidence: Note displayed: 'Profit is calculated from approved expenses in Expense Management only. Material, Vendor, and Payment Requests are workflow items and not counted as expenses.'

finance_analytics_tabs.description: Finance Analytics has 4 tabs: Overview, Project P&L, By Category, Expense Breakdown
finance_analytics_tabs.evidence: All 4 tabs visible and clickable: Overview, Project P&L, By Category, Expense Breakdown

expense_breakdown_tab.description: Expense Breakdown tab shows approved expenses grouped by category
expense_breakdown_tab.evidence: Expense Breakdown tab shows categories with amounts: Material Purchase (₹50.0K), Labor/Manpower (₹9.5K), Miscellaneous (₹6.0K), Travel & Accommodation (₹6.0K), Site Expenses (₹3.0K), Transport & Logistics (₹2.5K)

edit_project_modal_budget_readonly.description: Budget field in EditProjectModal is read-only for projects from Business Hub
edit_project_modal_budget_readonly.evidence: EditProjectModal shows: 1) 'From Business Hub Order' indicator, 2) Budget field labeled '(Set in Order Management)' in red, 3) Budget input field has gray background indicating read-only state, 4) Client and Location fields also show '(from order)' and are read-only
